info.title: featly
info.description: Featly — global dotnet tool. Migrations, environment lock/unlock, import/export, API key generation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Featly CLI — operate the Featly SQLite store and server from the command line.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: db
commands.description: Manage the Featly SQLite schema offline (operates directly on the database file).

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Apply all pending migrations so the schema matches this build.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: SQLite connection string or file path. Falls back to the FEATLY_SQLITE environment variable, then 'Data Source=featly.db'.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: SQLite connection string or file path. Falls back to the FEATLY_SQLITE environment variable, then 'Data Source=featly.db'.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Revert the schema down to a target migration. Destructive.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: SQLite connection string or file path. Falls back to the FEATLY_SQLITE environment variable, then 'Data Source=featly.db'.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (assume yes). Use in scripts.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Migration to roll back to. Use '0' to revert every migration.

commands.name: drop
commands.description: Delete the entire database (all tables and the migration history). Irreversible.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: SQLite connection string or file path. Falls back to the FEATLY_SQLITE environment variable, then 'Data Source=featly.db'.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (assume yes). Use in scripts.

commands.name: apikey
commands.description: Manage API keys against a running Featly server (online).

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Mint a new API key. The plaintext token is printed once.

options.name: --name
options.description: Human-readable label for the key.

options.name: --user
options.description: Bind the key to this user identifier (the key then acts as that user).

options.name: --scope
options.description: Key scope: AdminWrite (default) or SdkRead.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment key the key is scoped to (defaults to the server's default environment).

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Admin API key (Bearer). Falls back to the FEATLY_API_KEY environment variable.

commands.name: bootstrap-admin
commands.description: Provision the first admin on a fresh server. Prints an admin token once.

options.name: --identifier
options.description: Identifier for the first admin (email / OIDC subject / username).

options.name: --display
options.description: Display name for the admin (defaults to the identifier).

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

commands.name: env
commands.description: Manage environments against a running Featly server (online).

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Freeze an environment: reject all mutations until unlocked.

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Admin API key (Bearer). Falls back to the FEATLY_API_KEY environment variable.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Unfreeze an environment: allow mutations again.

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Admin API key (Bearer). Falls back to the FEATLY_API_KEY environment variable.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export an environment's flag/config/segment definitions as a JSON bundle.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment key to export (defaults to the server's default environment).

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the bundle to this file. Defaults to standard output.

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Admin API key (Bearer). Falls back to the FEATLY_API_KEY environment variable.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import a JSON bundle into an environment (upserts definitions by key).

options.name: --environment
options.description: Target environment key (defaults to the server's default environment).

options.name: --server-url
options.description: Featly server base URL. Falls back to the FEATLY_SERVER_URL environment variable, then 'http://localhost:5080'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Admin API key (Bearer). Falls back to the FEATLY_API_KEY environment variable.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a JSON bundle previously produced by 'featly export'.
